newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht higher, interbank rate eases late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht higher, interbank rate eases late.

text.p: The Thai baht firmed against the dollar in late trade on Monday as the U.S. unit's weakned in overseas markets, dealers said.
The baht was up to 25.943/25.953 to the dollar near the close from 25.957/25.960 in early morning, dealers said.
"The dollar was heavily sold throughout the day because the U.S. unit was relatively weak abroad," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
Dollar selling was also triggered by some inflow of foreign funds and improving sentiment in the baht, dealers said.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the mid-rate unchanged at 25.97 per dollar.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was quoted at 10.00/11.00 satangs late compared with 11.00/12.00 in early morning.
The overnight interbank rate eased to 9.75-10.00 percent late from 10.25-10.50 earlier because of the dollar selling, dealers said.
"Banks appeared to have plenty of funds today following the heavy selling of the dollar today," said one money market dealer.
